name: Enclave 7 Commissary
description: Allocated goods only. The shelves hold precisely what the Steward has decided Enclave 7 requires this quarter: not less, which would be cruelty, and not one item more, which would be waste. Nobody here has ever gone hungry. Nobody here has ever chosen dinner.

variants.description: The commissary, and half the shelves are now stocked by people rather than by allocation — surplus, trade, things somebody grew. It is untidy and it is louder than it used to be. Somewhere upstream, somebody opened something up.
The commissary. Two shelves, both rations, and a queue that does not talk. The allocation is correct, in the sense that everyone in it will eat.
